# Lisbon 5-Day Trip Plan: Apr 10–14, 2026

A relaxed, walkable Lisbon itinerary for 2 adults with museums, neighborhoods, and one day trip. Total on-the-ground budget target: **€1,800** excluding flights.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary and Cost Plan

### Day 1: Baixa, Chiado, and Alfama First Look
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and take an easy walk through **Baixa** and **Rossio**.
- Afternoon: Visit **Lisbon Story Centre** or **MUDE** if you want a light museum start; then stroll into **Chiado** for cafés and shopping.
- Evening: Sunset in **Alfama** and dinner near Miradouro de Santa Luzia.
- Transit tip: Use the metro or a taxi from the airport, then stay on foot in the center.
- Estimated cost for 2: **€180–€240** including local transit, museum entry, coffee, and dinner.

### Day 2: Belém Museums and Riverside Landmarks
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Head to **Belém** for **Jerónimos Monastery** and the **National Coach Museum**.
- Afternoon: Walk the riverfront, stop at **MAAT** if you want contemporary art and architecture, then rest at a café.
- Evening: Return to the city for a low-key dinner in **Cais do Sodré** or **Príncipe Real**.
- Transit tip: Use tram, bus, or rideshare to Belém; it is less convenient to do entirely on foot.
- Estimated cost for 2: **€220–€300** including museum tickets, transit, pastries, and dinner.

### Day 3: Day Trip to Sintra
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/train-front.svg
- Morning: Take an early train to **Sintra** and visit **Pena Palace** or **Quinta da Regaleira**.
- Afternoon: Keep the pace light with one major site plus a scenic walk in the historic center.
- Evening: Return to Lisbon and have an easy dinner near your hotel.
- Transit tip: Train from **Rossio Station** is the simplest option; use local buses or a short taxi in Sintra.
- Estimated cost for 2: **€180–€260** including train, entrance fees, local transport, snacks, and dinner.

### Day 4: Bairro Alto, Príncipe Real, and Museum Time
- Morning: Start slower with brunch, then visit **Museu Nacional de Arte Antiga** or **Calouste Gulbenkian Museum**.
- Afternoon: Walk through **Príncipe Real** and **Bairro Alto** with time for shopping, gardens, and a café break.
- Evening: Enjoy a scenic viewpoint and a flexible dinner plan.
- Transit tip: This is a great day for walking with short rides only if needed.
- Estimated cost for 2: **€170–€240** including museum entry, snacks, and dinner.

### Day 5: Slow Morning and Departure Buffer
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- Morning: Keep it light with a final neighborhood walk in **Mouraria** or **Alfama**, plus a long breakfast.
- Afternoon: Last-minute shopping, packing, and airport transfer.
- Evening: Departure day buffer for a stress-free exit.
- Transit tip: Leave extra time for airport transfer; Lisbon traffic can be slower than expected.
- Estimated cost for 2: **€70–€140** depending on transfer method and meals.

## Lisbon Budget Breakdown for 2 Adults

| Category | Planned Spend | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Hotels / stays | €700–€900 | Midrange central hotel or apartment, 4 nights |
| Food and drinks | €420–€560 | Breakfast, lunches, dinners, coffee, pastries |
| Local transit | €60–€110 | Metro, tram, bus, airport transfer, Sintra transit |
| Museums and attractions | €220–€320 | 3–5 paid entries plus day trip tickets |
| Day trip extras | €120–€180 | Sintra local transport, snacks, flexibility |
| Buffer / shopping | €160–€250 | Souvenirs, extra café stops, contingency |

## Best Pace and Transit Strategy

- Stay in **Baixa, Chiado, or Príncipe Real** for the easiest walkability.
- Use **walking for central days** and **metro/taxi for Belém and airport transfers**.
- For Sintra, go **early by train** and keep only one or two major sights to avoid overload.
- Build in one café break each afternoon so the trip feels balanced rather than rushed.

## Quick Actions
